---
title: "Before the day"
aliases:
  - /tracks/one-day-replication/before.html
---
Before the day you read the case study and the exercise overview, and check that the browser lab loads on the machine that you will bring, which takes about an hour and a quarter. Installing R, an IDE (Positron, RStudio, VS Code, etc.) and the downloadable workspace is optional and takes longer, and so is the reading at the end of this page. The day is worked mainly in the browser lab, a page of the course site on which R runs inside your browser, with the data already in place, so there is nothing that you have to install. The workspace holds the same tasks and gives the same numbers, and it is yours to keep after the day.

## 1. The case study

[Read the case study](../../cases/eu-frames/index.qmd){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

The case study presents the original study, with its questions, data and selections, then SCORE and the Multi100 project, the five reanalyses with an assessment of their choices, and how the results of the five analysts were put on one scale. Every part of the day works on this case.

## 2. The browser lab

[Open the browser lab at Task 1](../../cases/eu-frames/lab.qmd#task-1-setup){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

Open the lab once on the machine and in the browser that you will use, wait until the R engine has loaded and the first cell shows a "Run Code" button, and run the three cells of Task 1. If they run, and the second reports 270 rows, 27 countries and 10 years, you are set. If it does not load, try another browser, and tell the facilitator before the day.

## 3. The exercise

[Read the exercise overview](../../cases/eu-frames/exercise.qmd){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

The exercise overview sets out the claim that you will be working on, and the table of what the five Multi100 analysts found when they reanalysed it.

## 4. R and the workspace (optional)

[Install R and the workspace](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/setup.html){.btn .btn-outline-primary target="_blank"}

If you want to work in your IDE, install R and an IDE, download the [workspace of the EU-frames case](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/setup.html#the-workspace), and run `R/check_setup.R` until it reports no failure. You do this once. The [help page](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/help.html) lists the problems that other participants have met.

## 5. Repositories (optional)

[Read Reproducibility repositories](../../companion/repositories.qmd){.btn .btn-outline-primary target="_blank"}

The companion module on repositories covers archives, the OSF and the preregistration templates, in more depth than the day has time for.

**By the start of the day** you have the browser lab loading on the machine that you will use, or the workspace working if you installed it, and you know what the claim is and how far apart the results of the five Multi100 analysts are.
